title: Contributing
text: Create branch main. Add update tests every behavior change. Run devtools::document(), devtools::test(), devtools::check(). Avoid changing independent analysis unit away environment/environment-year without explicit statistical model. Submit pull request describing input assumptions, failure handling, backward-incompatible changes.

title: envwindowr 0.1.0
text: Initial GitHub-ready package. User-supplied daily weather, traits, environment-specific periods. Fixed multiple window sizes configurable scan steps. Mean, sum, minimum, maximum, median, standard deviation, custom summaries. Pearson, Spearman, Kendall correlation methods. Weather coverage checks, explicit status codes, adjusted p-values, rankings, diagnostics, plots. Simulated data known environmental signal.
